stories.title: The collapse of UN climate talks, over fossil fuels, was years in the making
stories.summary: Going into this year’s talks in Turkey, expectations were notably low. Still, the outcome was even worse than expected — a failure to reach an overall agreement at a time of frequent extreme weather events fueled by climate change.
